evidence.quote: 美国正在逐项明确链上资产怎样进入受监管金融体系的日常运作。讨论已经深入到客户资金管理、抵押品、交易组织、资本计量和监管记账这些后台环节。一项资产能在钱包里显示，与它能被期货经纪商计入客户资产、被清算机构接受为抵押品、被银行计入合规资本计算，是不同层次的事情。后面这些环节，才是Market Plumbing（市场管道），是真正在重构金融市场底层运作体系。

evidence.quote: CoinEx is shutting down, but its hot wallet system remains highly advanced and is worth learning from for others in the industry.

We introduced an MPC-based dual-signature scheme for our hot wallets to eliminate single points of failure. Our infrastructure is split into two systems run by completely independent teams: the business system and the wallet system. Each holds one private key, and every withdrawal or transfer must pass substantive risk review by both, in real time. If either

The hard part is that the wallet signing process has to be implemented independently, rather than relying on each node's native mechanism, which requires extensive re-engineering. It took us over a year to retrofit the vast majority of the nearly 300 chains supported by CoinEx, one by one.

items.author: nityasnotes
items.new_information: 作者自述小盘股EPS预测中位误差比一致预期低20%

evidence.quote: I used Shortcut to cut EPS forecast errors by 20% vs. Wall Street consensus.

I did this by backtesting Q2 2026 earnings forecasts for 113 small caps covered by 3+ analysts on Shortcut with Sol medium effort. Even after raising consensus by 2.7%, the best simple adjustment I found in hindsight, it only cut median errors by 4%, versus Shortcut’s 20%.

The reason I’m exploring this is because I believe that agents will give investors a starting point for companies they might not have previously had time to research. I used Shortcut’s generated spreadsheet models from the backtest to inspect, beyond just the final EPS estimate, which approaches held up. In 40% of forecasts, agents built up to EPS from
revenue, costs, taxes, and share count. For that group, median forecast errors were 32% lower than the Street’s.
This is still an early experiment, and I’d love to hear what y’all think I should try next and whether this could be useful :)
